name: SpoofNet
mission: GNSS jamming and spoofing, mapped from phones.
flowAlt: Data flow: per phone, a raw GNSS log (C/N0, AGC, clock, pseudoranges) from GnssLogger or the simulator is turned into features against a per-signal baseline, and a fitted detector raises jamming, spoofing or meaconing events. Each event goes up as a type, score and coarse cell under a daily token, never a track. The server clusters events from three or more contributors into an incident and locates the source from C/N0 loss with an uncertainty ellipse. Publication rules decide what each audience sees; the API and the MapLibre map serve it, with areas without phones drawn as no data.

nodes: no phones drawn as no data
